shots.content: Inside a café, a rectangular table stands beside the window, with a tall floor plant near one end and the counter beyond the other. A woman in an emerald blouse sits in the plant-side window seat and asks a question. A man in a mustard sweater sits in the counter-side window seat. A woman in a navy blazer sits in the plant-side aisle seat. A man in a burgundy hoodie sits in the counter-side aisle seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from the counter end, looking lengthwise along the rectangular table toward the floor plant, with both window-side seats and both aisle-side seats in frame.

shots.content: The woman in an emerald blouse at the plant-side window seat swaps seats with the man in a mustard sweater at the counter-side window seat, who speaks.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: The woman in a navy blazer asks a question, and the man in a burgundy hoodie answers.
shots.viewpoint: Top-down wide shot from directly above the rectangular table, centered on the tabletop, with both window-side seats and both aisle-side seats in frame.
